known_divergences.a/aggs_metric_with_subagg_error: real OpenSearch answers this malformed request with a 500; Warp returns the proper aggregation_initialization_exception (400)
known_divergences.a/percentile_ranks: OpenSearch answers percentile_ranks from a t-digest whose interpolation differs slightly from Warp's exact-centroid cdf
known_divergences.cat/aliases_shards_json: Warp does not list the unassigned replica shard row real OpenSearch reports for number_of_replicas=1
known_divergences.cat/count_and_health_json: Warp always reports cluster health green (no replica shards exist to be unassigned)
known_divergences.cat/unknown_endpoint_and_method: the list of allowed methods in a 405 body differs (real OpenSearch aggregates every route on the path)
known_divergences.doc/delete: Warp keeps no delete tombstones: the version of a delete of a missing document is 1, real OpenSearch continues the version sequence
known_divergences.idx/explain_api: the _explain explanation tree is a one-line summary, not Lucene's full BM25 breakdown
known_divergences.q/geo_bounding_box: Lucene encodes geo points to 32-bit ints, so a point exactly on the box boundary can fall on either side; Warp compares doubles
known_divergences.doc/scroll_doc_sort_and_total: _doc order is host-local: a scroll over several hosts returns them one host after the other
known_divergences.s/sort_score_then_field: the _score echoed in `sort` is the per-host score
known_divergences.s/terminate_after: terminate_after applies per host (per shard, as in OpenSearch with several shards)
